dashboard.recentGroupsHint: Recently updated actionable groups across all mailboxes.
dashboard.agentDisabled: Bounce causes will not be analyzed. Enable it under General settings.
dashboard.agentUnavailable: The command for provider "{{provider}}" was not found on the server. Analyses will fail.

mailbox.emptyAdminHint: Register a mailbox to monitor under Settings > Mailboxes.
mailbox.emptyUserHint: Ask an administrator to register a mailbox.
mailbox.disabledNote: This mailbox is disabled and is skipped by scheduled syncs.
mailbox.addressHint: The address to monitor. It is stored in lower case.
mailbox.enabledHint: When disabled, the mailbox is skipped by scheduled syncs.
mailbox.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
mailbox.sectionImapHint: How to reach the incoming mail server. The password is stored encrypted.
mailbox.sectionRangeHint: The first check looks back initial_days; later checks look back recent_days.
mailbox.initialDaysHint: Days to look back on the first sync (default 90)
mailbox.recentDaysHint: Days to look back on later syncs (default 30)
mailbox.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
mailbox.deleteMessage: Delete {{address}}? Its index and bounce groups are removed and cannot be restored.
mailbox.keepDataHint: When checked, stored raw messages stay on disk.

alerts.chooseMailbox: Choose the mailbox whose alerts you want to review.
alerts.scopeExcludedHint: Problems solved on the recipient side, such as missing addresses or full mailboxes. They are not analyzed.
alerts.searchPlaceholder: Search unit, authority, domain or diagnostic

report.title: Analysis report
report.runningHint: The agent is analyzing this group. The page refreshes automatically when it finishes.
report.noneHint: Press "Re-analyze" to have the agent explain the cause and suggest a fix.
report.excluded: Recipient-side problems (missing addresses, full mailboxes, ...) cannot be fixed by the sender, so the agent does not analyze them.

mails.chooseMailbox: Choose the mailbox whose messages you want to browse.

mail.subject: Subject
mail.htmlSandboxNote: The HTML is sanitized and shown with scripts and remote images disabled.

bounce.title: Bounce extraction
bounce.notBounce: This message was not classified as a bounce.

jobs.alreadyActive: The same job is already queued or running.

tools.description: Run fetch, grouping and analysis separately or together, rebuild the index, or redo the classification.
tools.adminOnlyTitle: Only administrators can reindex or reclassify
tools.adminOnly: Members can run sync, fetch, group and analyze. Ask an administrator when a reindex or reclassify is needed.
tools.allNote: With "All", one job is expanded per mailbox and they run in parallel within the worker limit.
tools.jobsHint: Active jobs refresh automatically. Jobs queued for "All" appear as one child job per mailbox.

sync.title: Sync all (fetch, group, analyze)
sync.description: Fetches mail, groups new bounces and analyzes the actionable groups. The same processing as a scheduled sync.

fetch.title: Fetch only
fetch.description: Stores mail not yet fetched from the IMAP server. No grouping or analysis.

group.title: Group only
group.description: Classifies fetched mail that is awaiting grouping, groups it and analyzes the groups awaiting analysis.

analyze.title: Analyze only
analyze.description: Runs the agent analysis, either for groups awaiting analysis or for every actionable group.

reindex.title: Reindex
reindex.description: Rebuilds the index database and re-parses, re-classifies and re-groups every stored raw message.
reindex.warning: This takes a while. Group states and analysis reports are kept only for groups that appear again.

reclassify.title: Reclassify
reclassify.description: Keeps the messages and re-runs only bounce classification and grouping. Use after classification rules change.

settings.description: Manage system settings and your own account.

menu.general: Sync times, workers, agent and server information
menu.mailboxes: Register, edit and test monitored mailboxes
menu.users: Add users, change roles and reset passwords
menu.tokens: Issue and revoke login tokens that replace a password

settings.checkTimesHint: All enabled mailboxes are synced automatically at these times (server local time).
settings.noCheckTimes: No sync times configured. Automatic syncs are off.
settings.invalidTime: Times must use the HH:MM format.
settings.jobsHint: Settings for the jobs that run in the background.
settings.workersHint: Number of jobs that run at the same time. Accounts on the same IMAP server are processed one after another automatically.
settings.workersInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 16.
settings.agentHint: The external CLI that analyzes bounce causes.
settings.providerUnavailableHint: The {{provider}} command was not found on the server. Install it or choose another provider.
settings.agentEnabledHint: When enabled, new bounces found by a sync are analyzed automatically.
settings.serverHint: Set by the start-up parameters. Cannot be changed here.

user.usernameHint: The ID used to log in.
user.roleHint: Administrators manage settings, users and mailboxes, and can reindex and reclassify.
user.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.
user.deleteMessage: Delete {{username}}? Their login tokens stop working too.
user.cannotDeleteLastAdmin: The last administrator cannot be deleted.
user.cannotDemoteLastAdmin: The last administrator cannot be demoted.

token.description: A login token is a secret string that can be used instead of a password to log in.
token.name: Name
token.nameHint: A name that tells what it is for (e.g. monitoring script)
token.expiresInvalid: Choose a date and time in the future.
token.createdOnce: This value is shown only once. Store it somewhere safe.
token.deleteMessage: Delete token "{{name}}"? Logging in with it will no longer work.

account.changePasswordHint: Confirm your current password, then set a new one.
account.sessionNote: Changing the password logs out every other device.

serverError.invalidCredentials: The username, password or token is incorrect.
serverError.lastAdmin: The last administrator cannot be removed or demoted.
serverError.jobNotQueued: This job has already started and cannot be canceled.

ip_blocked.label: Sending IP blocked
ip_blocked.description: The sending server's IP is on a block list. Request delisting at the listing service (the authority) and review what triggered it.

rate_limited.label: Rate limited
rate_limited.description: The recipient domain is throttling mail from this IP. Lower the sending rate and concurrency, then retry later.

auth_failure.label: Sender authentication failed
auth_failure.description: SPF, DKIM, DMARC or reverse DNS checks failed. Review the sending domain's DNS records and the sending server's configuration.

sender_blocked.label: Sender address rejected
sender_blocked.description: The recipient domain rejects mail from this sender address. Ask the recipient's administrator to unblock it, or change the sender address.

content_rejected.label: Content rejected
content_rejected.description: The body or an attachment was rejected as spam, a virus or by policy. Review the message content and attachments.

message_too_large.label: Message too large
message_too_large.description: The message exceeds the recipient's size limit. Reduce the attachments or share them another way.

server_config.label: Sending server misconfigured
server_config.description: Relay, TLS or HELO settings do not meet the recipient's requirements. Check the sending server (MTA) configuration.

unknown_failure.label: Unknown failure
unknown_failure.description: A delivery failure that matches no known pattern. Read the diagnostic and the source messages, and use the analysis report if needed.

user_unknown.label: Recipient does not exist
user_unknown.description: The recipient address does not exist. Remove it from the list or ask the recipient for the correct address.

mailbox_full.label: Recipient mailbox full
mailbox_full.description: The recipient's mailbox is over quota. Nothing can be done on the sending side; mail arrives once they free space.

mailbox_disabled.label: Recipient address disabled
mailbox_disabled.description: The recipient address is disabled or suspended. Remove it from the list or ask the recipient for another address.

domain_not_found.label: Recipient domain not found
domain_not_found.description: The recipient domain has no DNS (MX) record. Check the spelling; otherwise wait for the recipient's DNS to recover.

delivery_delay.label: Delivery delayed
delivery_delay.description: The recipient server is temporarily unreachable. Mail is retried automatically; contact the recipient side only if it persists.
